build_reindex_coco_json: build a function to convert 0-indexed COCO JSON files to 1-indexed and save to a temporary location
test_reindex_coco_function: test the reindex_coco_to_temp function with a sample COCO JSON file containing images, categories, and annotations
run_coco_reindex_validation: run the reindex_coco_to_temp function to validate and convert a COCO JSON file from 0-indexed to 1-indexed
review_coco_id_mapping: review the reindex_coco_to_temp function to ensure image_id and category_id references are updated consistently in annotations
summarize_coco_reindex: summarize the reindex_coco_to_temp function that converts COCO JSON data from 0-indexed to 1-indexed IDs
